days.rollupZh: 今日要闻聚焦企业AI落地：OpenAI扩大与ServiceNow、Oracle等合作，Legora和Retell涉及法律与通话场景。开发者侧，GitHub Octoverse显示智能体编程推动提交与推送创新高，Cursor推出Agent SDK，税务评估测试AI智能体。能源与政策议题同样受关注，包括固态变压器助力AI供电、Anthropic IPO及首例免用AI宗教豁免。
days.rollupEn: Today’s news centers on enterprise AI adoption, with OpenAI expanding partnerships with ServiceNow and Oracle, plus Legora and Retell applying AI to legal work and calls. On the developer side, GitHub’s Octoverse reports agent-driven commit and push highs, Cursor introduces an Agent SDK, and a new benchmark tests AI agents on tax tasks. Energy and policy also feature, from solid-state transformers for AI power to Anthropic’s IPO and a religious exemption from AI.
